items.name: building-neutral-amber-cache
items.title: Amber Cache portrait
items.subject: the AMBER CACHE, a breakable loot urn: a squat round urn of glossy bronze-brown ant chitin plates bound by two cream rope bands, its top sealed by a thick cap of glowing golden amber with two big amber nuggets in it. The glowing amber cap is the signature. No ground.

items.name: building-neutral-supply-crate
items.title: Beetle Supply Crate portrait
items.subject: the BEETLE SUPPLY CRATE, a breakable loot crate: a chunky square crate of dark riveted steel with thick brass corner bands, a big iron handle on its front and one glass vial of glowing violet liquid strapped to its side. Square silhouette, the violet vial as the one bright accent. No ground.

items.name: building-neutral-seed-pod
items.title: Fallen Seed Pod portrait
items.subject: the FALLEN SEED POD: a big woody ribbed husk split open into four curled spiky lobes like a tulip, three smooth pale seeds inside with a warm golden glow between them. Warm brown and cream. No ground.

items.name: building-neutral-rubble
items.title: Collapsed Rubble portrait
items.subject: COLLAPSED RUBBLE that blocks a path: a low, wide heap of big rounded ochre sand-clay clods and grey flat stones, a snapped pale root sticking out and one cracked clay arch fragment on top. Fill the frame's width with the long heap. No ground.

items.name: building-neutral-sap-spring
items.title: Sap Spring portrait
items.subject: the SAP SPRING, a healing fountain: a round hollow root stump with a thick bark rim, brimming with glowing warm golden sap that wells up in a small dome in the middle and spills over the rim. The glowing golden pool is the signature. No ground.

items.name: building-neutral-dew-spring
items.title: Dew Spring portrait
items.subject: the DEW SPRING, a mana fountain: a smooth pale stone bowl cradled by three big curled green leaves standing up like petals, filled with glowing blue-violet dew, one big violet dew drop hanging from the tallest leaf's tip. The glowing violet bowl and the drop are the signature. No ground.

items.name: building-neutral-merchant
items.title: Pill-Bug Peddler portrait
items.subject: the PILL-BUG PEDDLER, a travelling merchant: a friendly slate-grey pill bug with a tiny lantern on its antenna, harnessed in front of a small wooden cart piled with jars, potion bottles and amber, under a striped cream-and-rust awning. The striped awning and the pill bug's round armoured back are the signature. No ground.
